name: Spring presets
summary: Critically damped step responses solved in closed form. No integration, no drift, no overshoot.
api: x = to + resp(t − t0, from − to, v0, S.base)

name: Retarget as a sum
summary: Each new target adds one spring from its own start time. The value stays a pure sum you can scrub or render offline.
api: value(t) = to + Σ resp(t − tᵢ, prevᵢ − toᵢ, 0, cfg)

name: Stagger
summary: The same spring started 40ms apart per item. Order reads left to right without any keyframes.
api: items.forEach((x, i) => x.set(v[i], S.base, t + i*0.04))

name: Tabs with panel
summary: Indicator edges lag each other. The panel text swaps with blur while the panel height morphs to fit.
api: ind.go(l, r)   panel.h.set(measure(next))   swap.to(i)

name: Accordion
summary: Height springs to the measured body. The chevron turns on the same spring and the body fades in with height.
api: body.h.set(open ? inner.scrollHeight : 0)

name: Tooltip
summary: Enters on the base spring from 97% scale and 4px below. Exits faster on the snap spring so it never lingers. Studio’s current Tooltip has no enter or exit motion; this is the proposed behavior.
api: o.set(open ? 1 : 0, open ? S.base : S.snap)

name: Dismissible alert
summary: Fades and blurs out first, then the space collapses so content below never jumps while text is still visible.
api: o.set(0, S.snap); h.set(0, S.base, t + EXIT)

name: Flip card
summary: One rotation track on the soft spring. The card sinks 3% at the midpoint so the flip has depth without a bounce.
api: rot.set(front ? 0 : 180, S.soft)

name: Stepper
summary: The connector fills first, then the next node inks in after the lag. Completed nodes swap their number for a check.
api: line.set(step); node[i].set(step >= i, S.base, t + LAG)

name: Rating
summary: While the pointer is over it, the fill follows the cursor exactly. On leave it settles back to the saved value.
api: fill = hovering ? pointerX : v.at(t)

name: Count badge
summary: Digits roll up one slot at a time and slot widths spring, so 9 to 10 widens smoothly. The badge scales in from 60%.
api: digits.set(n)   badge.o.set(n > 0 ? 1 : 0)

name: Blur swap label
summary: Outgoing text blurs up and out in 100ms. Incoming text starts after it, while the pill width springs to fit.
api: w.set(measure(next)); swap.to(next)

name: Counter
summary: The number itself rides the lazy spring, so it decelerates into the final value instead of ticking linearly.
api: label = format(round(v.at(t)))

name: Progress bars
summary: Fills stagger by 40ms and percentages count with the same spring, so number and bar always agree.
api: bar[i].set(v, S.base, t + i*0.04)

name: Line chart
summary: The line draws on the lazy spring through stroke-dashoffset. The dot and tooltip follow the nearest point on the snap spring.
api: dashoffset = L·(1 − draw.at(t))   tip.x.set(xᵢ, S.snap)

name: Bar chart
summary: Switching datasets retargets every bar mid-flight with a stagger. Labels stay on a fixed 0–100 scale.
api: bar[i].h.set(data[i], S.base, t + i*0.03)

name: Donut
summary: Segments sweep in together on one spring. Hovering a segment thickens it and swaps the center label.
api: seg.len = vᵢ·draw(t)   seg.width.set(hover ? 22 : 16)

name: Timeline
summary: The spine fills to the current milestone first. The node inks in after the lag, then its row brightens.
api: spine.set(y[i]); node[i].set(1, S.base, t + LAG)

name: Countdown
summary: Remaining time is computed from the clock each frame. Only digits that change roll, each on its own swap.
api: digits.set(format(T − t))

name: Before / after
summary: The divider sits exactly under the pointer while dragging. Clicking elsewhere springs it there instead.
api: x = held ? pointer : x.at(t)

name: Carousel
summary: Drag follows the pointer 1:1 with rubber-banding at the ends. Release projects the velocity forward to pick a slide, then settles from that velocity.
api: i = round((x − v·0.2)/step); x.release(x, v, i·step)

name: Marquee
summary: Offset is the closed-form integral of a speed spring, so slowing on hover is smooth and the position is still a pure function of time.
api: x(t) = v₀t + Σ dᵢ·[(t − tᵢ) − R(t − tᵢ)],  R(T) = 2/ω(1 − e^{−ωT}) − Te^{−ωT}

name: Gallery lightbox
summary: The thumbnail itself grows to fill the frame: position, size and radius each spring from its measured rect. Closing reverses into the same slot.
api: box.{x,y,w,h,r}.set(open ? frame : thumbRect)

name: Player
summary: Play and pause share eight points on one spring. Progress is computed from the play start time, so scrubbing just rewrites that start.
api: progress(t) = playing ? p0 + (t − t0)/dur : p0

name: Poll
summary: Each option morphs in place into its result bar. Fills stagger, percentages count up and the chosen row keeps a check.
api: opt[i].fill.set(pct[i], S.base, t + i*0.05)

name: Text field
summary: The label floats on focus. On blur the field settles into one of three states: neutral, valid in the success color with a check, or invalid in the danger color with a message.
api: status.to(valid ? "ok" : "error")   border = mix(status color, line)

name: Subscribe
summary: An invalid address rings the field in the danger color and opens a message. A valid one shrinks the button into a spinner, turns it success-colored with a check, then morphs the whole field into a tinted confirmation pill.
api: err.set(1) → ring(danger)   plan(loading, check → success, done → success-tint)

name: Signature pad
summary: Ink follows the pointer exactly. Stroke width thins with speed, and Clear fades the ink out on a spring before wiping.
api: width = 3.2 − clamp(speed/1800)·2   ink.set(0, S.snap)

name: Rubber-band slider
summary: While held, the value is the pointer. Past the ends the pill stretches with rising resistance, then springs back from release velocity.

name: Nav hover
summary: A hover plate follows the pointer with lagging edges and fades out on leave. The underline marks the current page with the same edge rule.
api: plate.go(l, r); plate.o.set(hovering ? 1 : 0)

name: Header, progress, jump to top
summary: The progress bar tracks scroll 1:1. The header compacts once you leave the top. The back-to-top button enters after one screen and scrolls home on a spring that any wheel input cancels.
api: bar = scrollTop / max   hdr.set(scrolled ? 1 : 0)   scroll.set(0, S.soft)

name: Mobile menu
summary: The three lines morph into a cross on one spring. The panel height opens and each link enters 40ms after the last.
api: open.set(1); link[i].o.set(1, S.base, t + 0.08 + i*0.04)

name: Search expand
summary: The icon button widens into the field while the brand fades, and the input appears once the shape has mostly opened. As you type, results open below. Matching rows spring into place with the match in bold, misses blur out, and the highlight follows the arrow keys.
api: w.set(open ? 220 : 36)   results.o.set(query)   row.y.set(k·52)   row.o.set(match)

name: Pricing toggle
summary: The segment indicator uses lagging edges. Only the digits that change roll. The billing note swaps and the savings pill enters.
api: digits.set(price)   note.to(mode)   save.o.set(yearly)

name: Add to cart
summary: The button confirms in place with a blur swap and fills with the success color, then returns. The cart count rolls when the item arrives, 300ms later.
api: btn.to("added"); cart.set(n, t + 0.3); btn.to("add", t + 1.6)

name: Checkout totals
summary: Quantity digits roll, and every money value springs toward its new total, so subtotal, tax and total move together.
api: total.set(sum); label = money(total.at(t))

name: Switch
summary: The knob leads with one edge and trails with the other. While pressed it widens toward where it will go. The track inks in on the same spring.
api: knob.go(l, r)   press.set(down ? 1 : 0, S.snap)

name: Toast stack
summary: Success, warning and error toasts carry their status color on the icon and the action. New toasts push older ones back in depth. Drag one sideways 1:1; a long or fast swipe flings it out from release velocity, a short one springs home.

name: Dropdown
summary: The menu grows from the trigger at 97% scale while items fade in 30ms apart. Picking one swaps the button label.
api: menu.o.set(open); item[i].o = prog(t, tOpen + i*0.03)

name: Bottom sheet (mobile only)
summary: For phone layouts only: on wider screens Studio’s admin slides sheets in from the side (see Side detail sheet). Opens on the base spring. Dragging the grabber follows the finger; pulling up rubber-bands. Release past 30% or with a fast flick closes it from that velocity.
api: y.release(y, vy, y > 0.3H || vy > 500 ? H : 0)

name: Command palette
summary: Rows spring to their new slots as the filter changes and hidden rows blur out in place. The highlight moves with lagging edges. Arrow keys and Enter work.
api: row.y.set(k·36)   row.o.set(match)   hl.go(top, bottom)

name: Morph surface
summary: Button, loader, check, dynamic island and toast are one element. Width, height, radius and ink ride springs, and the check fills with the success color. Content swaps by the blur rule. The run is a list of timed events.
api: plan([[0,"loader"],[1.1,"check"],[1.9,"island"],[3.6,"toast"],[5.6,"button"]])

name: Copy button
summary: The icon button widens to fit “Copied”, turns success-colored and swaps its content, then returns after 1.6 seconds.
api: w.set(measure("Copied")); ok.set(1); after(1.6, reset)

name: Sortable table
summary: Sorting never re-renders the rows. Each row springs to its new slot with a 20ms stagger, and the header arrow turns on the same spring.
api: row.y.set(rank·36, S.base, t + rank·0.02)   arrow.set(asc ? 0 : 180)

name: Table of contents
summary: The active marker tracks the section you are reading, with lagging edges so it stretches between short and long entries. Clicking an entry scrolls there on a spring.
api: active = last heading above scrollTop   marker.go(top, bottom)

name: Breadcrumbs
summary: Middle crumbs fold into one ellipsis button. Each crumb’s width springs to zero while its text fades, so the trail closes from the inside out.
api: crumb.w.set(collapsed ? 0 : measured, S.base, t + i·0.03)

name: Checklist
summary: The box fills, the check draws, and a strike line runs through the text, each 40ms after the last. The done count rolls.
api: box.set(1); check.set(1, S.base, t + 0.04); strike.set(1, S.base, t + 0.08)

name: Skeleton to content
summary: Placeholders pulse on a 1.2-second clock while loading. When data lands, each row swaps from skeleton to content 50ms after the one above.
api: pulse = 0.55 + 0.25·cos(2πt/1.2)   row.swap.to("data", tLoad + i·0.05)

name: Image blur-up
summary: A tiny blurred placeholder holds the space. When the image decodes, blur and a 4% overscale settle together on the lazy spring, so the sharpening reads as focus, not a pop.
api: blur = 14·(1 − p)   scale = 1 + 0.04·(1 − p)   p = load.at(t)

name: Filtered collection
summary: Cards that leave the filter blur out in place. Cards that stay spring to their new grid slot, staggered by slot, and the grid height follows.
api: card.{x,y}.set(slot(i), S.base, t + i·0.03)   card.o.set(match)

name: Donation amount
summary: The amount indicator stretches between chips. “Other” opens a field below on a height spring, and the button’s amount rolls digit by digit.
api: ind.go(l, r)   other.h.set(1)   digits.set(amount)

name: Date and time picker
summary: The selection disc glides between days on two axes. Time slots for the new day blur in 40ms apart after the old ones leave.
api: disc.{x,y}.set(cell)   slot[i].swap.to(day, t + i·0.04)

name: Paywall unlock
summary: The lock’s shackle swings open first. Then the gate card exits and the fade over the hidden text lifts from top to bottom.
api: shackle.set(1); gate.o.set(0, S.snap, t + 0.25); mask.set(1, S.lazy, t + 0.3)

name: Pay button
summary: Processing keeps the button in place with a spinner. Success fills it with the success color; a decline fills it with danger and opens a fix-it message. Both settle back to a retryable state.
api: plan(processing → paid | declined)   fill = mix(success | danger, ink)

name: Diagram build
summary: Each node arrives 180ms after the last, and each connector draws from its source only after that source has landed, so the flow reads in order.
api: node[i].o = prog(t, t0 + i·0.18)   edge.draw = prog(t, t0 + from·0.18 + 0.12)

name: Statement reveal
summary: Words enter one by one, 50ms apart, using the same blur-and-rise as a content swap. Nothing moves once the line is complete.
api: word[i] = enter(prog(t, t0 + i·0.05))

name: Multi-step form
summary: Panels slide sideways in the direction of travel with the blur swap. An empty required field rings in the danger color with a message; the final step confirms in the success color.
api: panel.to(i, dir)   progress.set(i/(n − 1))   err.set(empty)

name: Select
summary: The list grows from the trigger. A highlight plate follows hover and arrow keys with lagging edges. Choosing moves the check, closes the list and swaps the trigger label.
api: list.o.set(open)   hl.go(top, bottom)   label.to(i)   check[i].set(1)

name: Combobox
summary: Typing filters in place. Matches spring into their new rows, misses blur out, and the matched letters bold. With no match, an “Add” row takes the first slot. The list height follows the count.
api: row.y.set(k·34)   row.o.set(match)   list.h.set(min(n, 5)·34 + 12)

name: Popover
summary: The panel and its arrow grow out of the trigger on one spring. Copy swaps in a success check, then reverts. Clicking outside or pressing Escape closes it faster than it opened.
api: pv.o.set(open, open ? S.base : S.snap)   origin = arrow tip

name: Context menu
summary: Right-click, or long-press on touch, opens the menu at the pointer. It grows from that exact corner and flips when it would overflow. Items fade in 25ms apart; the destructive item is danger-colored.
api: menu.at(pointer); origin = flipped ? "right" : "left"; item[i].o = prog(t, tOpen + i·0.025)

name: Hover card
summary: Opens only after the pointer rests for 400ms, so passing over the link does nothing. Leaving starts a 150ms grace period, and moving into the card cancels it.
api: openAt = t + 0.4 on enter; closeAt = t + 0.15 on leave; card enter cancels closeAt

name: Confirm dialog
summary: The scrim fades while the dialog rises 8px from 96% scale. Confirming closes the dialog first, then the deleted row collapses, so the change happens where you are looking.
api: dlg.o.set(1); on confirm: dlg.o.set(0, S.snap); row.h.set(0, S.base, t + 0.15)

name: Navigation drawer
summary: The drawer slides in from the edge while its links follow 35ms apart. It tracks a drag 1:1, rubber-bands when pulled past open, and closes past halfway or on a fast flick.
api: x.release(x, vx, x < −W/2 || vx < −500 ? −W : 0)

name: Navigation menu
summary: Moving between triggers keeps one panel open and morphs its position, width and height to the new content. The content slides in from the side you moved toward.
api: pn.{x,w,h}.set(target)   content.to(i, dir)

name: Bottom navigation bar
summary: The active indicator pill grows outward from the icon’s center while the previous one shrinks back into it. Icon and label ink in on the same spring.
api: pill[i].w.set(active ? 56 : 0)   label.weight = active

name: Pagination
summary: The number strip slides to keep the current page centered, clamped at the ends. The active plate moves with lagging edges, so it stretches on long jumps.
api: strip.set(−clamp(i·36 − 72, 0, max))   plate.go(i·36, i·36 + 36)

name: Radio group
summary: The inner dot grows from the center of the new choice while the old one shrinks, on the same spring. Arrow keys move the choice.
api: dot[i].set(i === picked ? 1 : 0)

name: Checkbox with mixed state
summary: The parent box morphs its check into a dash when only some children are on. The three points of the check slide to a flat line on one spring, with no swap.
api: mark = lerp(CHECK, DASH, mixed.at(t))   fill.set(any checked)

name: Toggle group
summary: Formatting buttons are independent, so each fills on its own spring. Alignment is single-choice, so one plate slides between options with lagging edges.
api: bold.on.set(!on)   align.go(l, r)

name: One-time code
summary: Each digit rolls into its box and a focus ring slides to the next box with lagging edges. A full code turns every box success or danger; a wrong code clears itself after a beat.
api: box[i].to(digit)   ring.go(x[i])   status → success | danger

name: Tag input
summary: A new chip opens its own width before its text fades in. Removing reverses it: text out first, then the gap closes, so neighbors slide over instead of jumping.
api: chip.w.set(measured); chip.o.set(1, S.base, t + 0.06)   remove: o→0, then w→0

name: Drag to reorder
summary: The held row lifts and follows the pointer exactly. The others spring aside the moment it crosses their midpoint. On release it settles into its slot from your release velocity.
api: held.y = pointer   others.y.set(slot)   held.y.release(y, vy, slot·50)

name: File drop zone
summary: Dragging a file over the zone inks its border and tints it. Each file opens its row, fills its bar, then ends in a success check or a danger message. Files never leave your browser.
api: zone.over.set(dragging)   bar = load.at(t)   end → success | danger

name: Extended action button
summary: Scrolling down hides the label first, then the button shrinks to its icon. Scrolling up reverses the order: the button widens, then the label fades in.
api: collapse: label.o→0 now, w→52 at t + 0.1   expand: w now, label at t + 0.12

name: Action button fan-out
summary: Opening turns the plus into a cross and fans the actions out from the button, 40ms apart, upward, to the side, or along an arc. Labels follow their buttons in the straight layouts; the arc stays icon-only so labels never collide. Closing gathers them back in reverse order.
api: item[i].{x,y}.set(open ? layout(dir, i) : 0, S.base, t + i·0.04)   icon.rot.set(open ? 45 : 0)

name: Avatar group
summary: Hovering the stack fans the avatars apart with a 30ms stagger. Hovering one face shows its name above it with the popover rule.
api: avatar[i].x.set(open ? i·44 : i·24, S.base, t + i·0.03)

name: Shape-morph loader
summary: Like a drop of water: five ripples of 2 to 6 lobes are always present, and each swells and drifts at its own slow rate. Nothing ever switches or holds, so the outline flows continuously while it turns, and every frame still comes from the clock.
api: r(θ,t) = 0.9 + Σ aₖ(t)·cos(kθ + φₖ(t)), drawn as a smooth closed spline

name: Resizable panels
summary: The divider follows the pointer exactly between its limits and rubber-bands beyond them. Releasing under 70px snaps the sidebar shut from your release velocity; a double-click springs it back.
api: w = clamp(start + dx, 120, max) ± rb   release: w < 70 ? 0 : w

name: Collapsible sidebar
summary: Collapsing fades every label first, then narrows the rail to its icons. Expanding widens the rail first, then brings labels back 30ms apart, so text never squeezes.
api: collapse: labels.o→0, w.set(56, t + 0.1)   expand: w.set(200), labels at t + 0.12 + i·0.03

name: Long answer
summary: The box grows a line at a time on a spring instead of jumping. The counter turns warning at 90% of the limit and danger past it.
api: h.set(mirror.offsetHeight)   counter = mix(warning | danger, muted)

name: Number stepper
summary: Digits roll up when the value rises and down when it falls, so direction is readable at a glance. Holding a button repeats after 400ms, every 80ms, on the clock.
api: digits.dir = ±1; digits.set(n)   repeat at t0 + 0.4 + k·0.08

name: Phone number
summary: Digits format as you type for the chosen country. Switching country swaps the code with a blur and reformats the number. A complete number earns a success check.
api: value = format(digits, country)   cc.to(country)   ok.set(complete)

name: Multi-select
summary: Ticking an option adds a chip to the trigger, which opens its width before its text appears. Unticking reverses it. The list stays open so you can pick several.
api: chip.w.set(1); chip.o.set(1, t + 0.06)   box.fill.set(on)

name: Matrix
summary: Each row has one dot that slides between columns instead of a fresh fill per cell. A row inks a success check once answered.
api: row.dot.x.set(colX)   row.done.set(1)

name: Time wheel
summary: Each column follows a drag exactly, then projects your release velocity forward and settles on the nearest value. Rows fade and shrink with distance from the center band.
api: i = round((y − v·0.15)/36); y.release(y, v, i·36)

name: Satisfaction faces
summary: One large face holds a continuous mood value. Its mouth curve and eye height follow the hovered or chosen score on a spring, so moving across the scale reads as one expression changing.
api: mouth.cy = lerp(−8, 10, mood.at(t))   label.to(score)

name: NPS scale
summary: The selection plate slides across the scale with lagging edges and changes color by band: danger for 0–6, warning for 7–8, success for 9–10. The caption swaps to match.
api: plate.go(l, r)   color.set(band)   caption.to(band)

name: Click to rank
summary: Clicking an item gives it the next rank: a numbered badge grows in and the item springs up into ranked order. Clicking a ranked item removes it and closes the gap.
api: item.y.set(slot(order))   badge.o.set(ranked)   badge.digits.set(rank)

name: Picture choice
summary: Choosing a card presses it in slightly, inks its border and pops a check badge in the corner. Letter keys pick an option, as in conversational forms.
api: card.sel.set(1); badge.o.set(1, S.base, t + 0.05)   keys A–D

name: One question at a time
summary: Each answer moves the question up and out while the next rises from below. Choices take letter keys and confirm with a short pulse before advancing. Enter submits text, and the progress bar fills per answer.
api: q.to(i)   enter y +24 → 0, exit 0 → −24   pulse, then advance at t + 0.45

name: Popup, slide-in and bar
summary: Three ways to show one sign-up form. A popup scales up over a scrim, a slide-in rises from the corner, and a bar drops from the top without blocking. Each waits 1.2 seconds, and closing is quicker than opening.
api: show at t0 + 1.2   popup: scale .96→1 + scrim · slide-in: y 24→0 · bar: y −100%→0

name: Prize wheel
summary: The wheel turns on a slow critically damped spring toward a precomputed angle, so it decelerates smoothly and stops without rocking back. The result swaps in once it settles.
api: angle.set(current + 5 turns + slice offset, { w: 1.8 })   on settle: result.to(prize)

name: Password with strength
summary: Meter segments fill in order as strength rises, shifting from danger to warning to success. Each requirement draws its own check when met. The eye icon’s slash draws on and off.
api: seg[i].set(score > i, S.base, t + i·0.04)   req.check.set(met)   slash.set(hidden)

name: Range slider
summary: Each thumb follows its drag exactly and stops at the other thumb. Histogram bars inside the range ink in while the rest fade, each on its own spring.
api: lo = clamp(pointer, 0, hi − step)   bar[i].in.set(lo ≤ x ≤ hi)

name: Selection toolbar
summary: The toolbar appears above the selection and glides to the next selection instead of jumping. It leaves quickly when the selection collapses.
api: tb.{x,y}.set(selectionCenter)   tb.o.set(hasSelection)

name: Slash command menu
summary: Typing “/” opens the menu right at the caret. Typing more filters it in place, the highlight follows with lagging edges, and Enter inserts a block that opens below.
api: menu.at(caretX)   rows.filter(query)   block.h.set(1)

name: Autosave status
summary: The status moves through Editing, Saving with a spinner, and Saved with a success check, then relaxes to a quiet “Saved just now”. Each change is a blur swap timed from your last keystroke.
api: on input: to("editing"); idle 0.8s → "saving"; +0.6s → "saved"; +2s → "idle"

name: Live collaborators
summary: Remote cursors glide word to word with name flags, and each person’s avatar joins the stack with a ring in their color. Positions are scheduled on the clock, so the scene replays identically.
api: cursor.{x,y}.set(word[i] rect) every 1.3s   avatar.o.set(1)

name: Suggested edit
summary: Accepting fades the struck word and closes its gap, while the inserted word loses its suggestion color. Rejecting does the reverse. The sentence reflows on springs, not jumps.
api: accept: del.o→0, del.w→0 at t + 0.1; ins.tint→0   reject: mirror

name: Canvas pan and zoom
summary: Zoom keeps the point under the pointer fixed, so you zoom into what you are looking at. Pan follows the drag exactly and coasts briefly after release.
api: s′ = s·e^(−Δ·0.002);  t′ = c − (c − t)·s′/s   pan: release(x, v, x + v·0.25)

name: Select, move and snap
summary: Moving and resizing follow the pointer, but within 8px of the other shape’s edges or center the box is pulled into alignment on a stiff spring, and a red guide marks the match.
api: x = near(raw, guides, 8) ?? raw; box.x.set(x, S.snap)   guide.o.set(snapped)

name: Color picker
summary: Both handles follow the pointer exactly while dragging. Picking a preset springs both handles to that color, so you can see where it lives in the space.
api: held ? pointer : {s,v,h}.set(preset)   swatch = hsv(h, s, v)

name: Layer tree
summary: Groups open and close on a height spring with their chevrons turning. The selection plate slides between rows with lagging edges, and hiding a layer fades its name while the eye closes.
api: group.h.set(open)   sel.go(top, bottom)   row.vis.set(shown)

name: Undo and redo
summary: Undo and redo spring the shape between saved states. A dashed ghost stays at the state you just left and fades out, so you can see what changed.
api: state = history[i]; props.set(state)   ghost = previous, o: 1 → 0 over 0.5s

name: Swipe actions
summary: The row follows your finger. The action behind it fills with its color and its icon grows once you pass the 80px threshold. Release past it and the row leaves and its space closes; otherwise it springs home.
api: x = pointer   armed = |x| > 80   out: x.release(x, v, ±W); h.set(0, t + 0.15)

name: Undo send
summary: Send shrinks the draft away and a toast takes over with a ring that empties over 5 seconds. Undo brings the draft back exactly. When the ring runs out, the toast swaps to a success “Sent”.
api: ring = 1 − (t − tSend)/5   undo: draft.o.set(1)   at 5s: label.to("sent")

name: Collapsed thread

name: Page load bar

name: Link preview

api: open at t + 0.3   card.{x,y}.set(link rect)   content.to(i)

name: Streaming answer
summary: Words arrive on a schedule and each one fades up out of a slight blur, so the text feels written rather than printed. A soft caret rides the last word. Stop freezes the answer where it is.

name: Product page

summary: One bar fills as you move Cart, Details, Payment, Receipt, and panels slide sideways in the direction of travel with the blur swap. Changing a quantity rolls its digit first, then every money value springs to the new total together; shipping goes free at $100. Empty required fields ring in danger. Pay shows a spinner, then fills success and slides to the receipt, where the check draws and the total counts up. With Simulate decline the button and bar flash danger, a message swaps in, and you stay on Payment.

Then the three cards change in one wave from left to right, 60ms apart: price digits roll and the billing note blur-swaps. The Save 20% pill enters once the wave has passed (it leaves at once on monthly). The Studio card rests lifted with its button filled. name: Analytics dashboard
summary: Change the range or the source and three regions answer in order, 80ms apart. First the stat numbers spring and each delta chip blurs over to its new sign and color. Then the line morphs point by point, left to right, onto a rescaled axis whose labels swap. Last the table rows spring to their new ranks while the view counts roll.

name: Notification center
summary: The bell opens a panel that pops out of its own corner. Clicking a row shrinks its dot, mixes its text to muted and rolls the badge down. Mark all read clears the dots top to bottom 40ms apart, rolls the badge to 0, then the badge exits. Every 5 seconds on the clock a notification arrives: the badge rolls up and, if the panel is open, the row enters at the top on a height spring that pushes the rest down.

summary: Start setup swaps the welcome card for the checklist while the card height springs to fit. Opening a task slides its body out in place. Mark done runs in order: box fills, check draws, strike runs through, then 40ms later the ring fills and the count rolls, then the task closes and the next one opens. When the fourth lands the checklist fades, the card shrinks around the finished state, and the success circle draws, then its check, then the message, then Continue. No confetti.

summary: Order: eyebrow, then the headline words 40ms apart, then the supporting line, then both buttons together, then the product image rises 28px with a slight scale from 0.98. Everything settles in about one second and then holds perfectly still. It plays again whenever it scrolls back into view.

Opening a quote first collapses any other open one, then grows the card in place; only the cards beneath it in the same column move.

summary: A row click dims the list and slides the sheet in from the right on the base spring. The rows behind stay live, so picking another row swaps the sheet content (exit, then enter) without sliding again. Picking a row measures its rect and the chip starts there at the row’s size and radius, then x, y, width, height and radius spring to the chip’s slot in the field while the row’s text swaps for the chip’s. api: chip.{x,y,w,h,r}.jump(rowRect).set(slot, S.soft)   face.to(chip)   row.o.set(0); rows.y.set(i·40)   field.h.set(rows)

name: Notice banner
summary: The notice slides down inside a slot whose height springs open, so the dashboard rows are pushed down rather than covered. Next notice cross-morphs the banner fill and border between info, warning and danger while the old copy exits and the new copy enters, never overlapping. Dismiss fades the copy out first, then collapses the slot height after 100ms, and the rows rise to fill it.
api: slot.h = H·natural   sev[k].set(k === next)   swap.to(next)   dismiss: text.set(0); H.set(0, t + EXIT)

name: Consent banner
summary: The banner rises from the bottom edge. Customize does not open a dialog: the intro fades and its height collapses while the four categories grow in place and the title swaps, and the middle button swaps to Save preferences. Every optional switch starts off, the three buttons carry equal weight, and focus lands on Necessary only. After a choice the copy exits first, then the same surface morphs its size, radius and position into a small tab in the corner; the tab label enters last. Clicking the tab reverses it.
api: rise: y.set(0)   customize: intro.h.set(0), cats.h.set(measure), title.swap()   choose: copy.set(0); box.{w,h,x,r}.set(tab, t + EXIT); label.set(1, t + EXIT + .1)

name: Bulk selection bar
summary: Selecting the first row opens a slot above the table: its height springs open and pushes the rows down, then the bar rises into it 50ms later with the count in rolling digits. The header checkbox morphs between empty, check and a dash for mixed. Delete removes the selected rows top-down, 100ms apart: each row fades, then its height collapses, and the count rolls down; the bar leaves only after the last row has gone. Archive swaps each status chip and Clear releases the rows the same way.
api: bar.h.set(n > 0); bar.o.set(n > 0, t + .05); count.set(n)   delete: rows[k].o.set(0, t + k·.1); .h.set(0, t + k·.1 + EXIT); bar.leave(after last)

name: Snackbar with action
summary: The snackbar rises from the bottom edge while a thin bar under it drains over six seconds. Hovering or focusing the snackbar pauses the countdown and resuming pushes the deadline back by exactly the paused time. Open swaps its label to Done with a tint morph, the countdown freezes, and the snackbar leaves 0.9s later. Dismiss and the timeout use the same exit.
api: o.set(1); remaining = deadline − t   hover: pausedAt = t; leave: deadline += t − pausedAt   action: swap.to(1); out at t + .9

name: Avatar picker
summary: Choosing a preset cross-fades the picture: the new image fades in over the old one, which stays opaque underneath until the new one is whole, so the circle is never blank. The selection ring moves between presets with lagging edges. Upload draws a progress ring around the avatar while the picture dims, then the ring fades, the photo cross-fades in, and the status line swaps its message.
api: new.o.set(1) over old (old held until new ≥ .995)   ring.go(l, r)   upload: ring.p.set(.18 → .52 → .83 → 1); photo.o.set(1); status.swap()

name: Date range selector
summary: The range is one tint plate per week row. When the end day moves, each row’s plate retargets with two edges: the leading edge goes first and the trailing edge lags 60ms, and rows farther from the start row begin 30ms later, so the highlight pours along the weeks. Hovering after the first click previews the range. Preset buttons animate the same plates, the endpoint discs scale in, the count rolls, and the label swaps.
api: rows[r].edges.go(left, right, t + |r − startRow|·.03)   end discs: s.set(isEnd)   count.set(days)   label.swap()

name: Timeline scrubber
summary: The playhead follows the pointer 1:1. The record panel above always shows the latest step on or before the playhead date: when the playhead passes a step, the panel copy swaps (exit, then enter) and the two counters roll. Release projects the throw forward by the release velocity and springs to the nearest dated step. Arrow keys step between dates.
api: u = held ? p.x / w : pos.at(t)   state = last(step ≤ u)   release: pos.release(u, v/w, nearest(u + v·.15), S.soft)

name: Revision history
summary: Each saved version shows a live relative time and its author. Hover or focus a version and the preview swaps (old text out in 100ms, then the new text in) to show what restoring would change: added words in a success tint, removed words struck in danger. Selecting a row opens Restore in place, which swaps to an inline confirmation, then to Restoring. Last, the removed words collapse and the tints fade so the current draft becomes the restored text, and a new entry enters at the top.
api: body.swap(diff(current, version))   row.ah.set(H[restore|confirm|busy])   m.set(1): del.w→0, ins.tint→0   entry.e.set(1)

name: Annotation review canvas
summary: Click the design: a dot marks the spot, the pin falls onto it, and only then does a comment card grow out of the pin. Pins follow the pointer 1:1 when dragged and settle from release velocity, and the card travels with the pin it belongs to. Resolving collapses the card into its pin as the pin turns to a success check. The side list shares selection: its highlight plate moves between rows with the leading edge first.
api: pin.fy.set(0) after fy=−28   card.o.set(1): rect lerp(pin 24×24 → card)   pin.rs.set(1) + card.o.set(0) on resolve   plate.go(top, bottom)

name: Auth shell
summary: One card holds every pane, so the frame never changes. Going to Forgot password or Enter code, the old pane slides out 18px and fades (100ms), then the next pane arrives from the direction of travel. The card’s height springs to the new pane on the same tick, so it never jumps. An error opens a danger line inside the card and adds its height to the same spring. The primary button swaps its label while it works. Everything here is demo text and nothing is sent.
api: pane.swap(next, dir)   card.h.set(measure(next))   error.set(1): h += e·errH   btn.label.to(working)

name: Funnel report
summary: Four bars grow from the baseline left to right, 120ms apart, and each stage count rolls up as its bar rises. The drop-off chip between two stages counts up just after the bar it follows. Changing the date range morphs every bar to its new height in the same stage order while the numbers roll, and the period text swaps. Hovering a stage dims the others and raises a tooltip that glides between bar tops and swaps its text.
api: bar[i].set(v[i]/v[0], soft, t + i·.12)   count[i].set(v[i], soft, same)   drop[i].set(d, soft, t + i·.12 + .1)   dim[j].set(j === hot ? 1 : .4, snap)

name: Settings shell
summary: The nav plate edges between items, leading edge first, and tints to danger on Danger zone. Panes swap by nav order: going down they leave upward and the next arrives from below, going up the reverse, never overlapping, while the content area height springs to the next pane. Changing any control starts that pane’s own Saving… then Saved flash inline, then fades. Danger zone reveals a typed confirmation that grows the pane, arms the button only once the site name matches, and replaces itself with a scheduled message and Undo. Narrow: the nav becomes a top segmented row.
api: plate.go(l, r) + go(t, b)   dir = next > cur ? 1 : -1   pane.swap(dir·10)   height.set(measure(pane))   saved: saving → (due) → saved → (due) → idle

name: Connected servers
summary: Each row is one server. Its chip morphs fill, label and width between connected, connecting, error and disconnected while the action button swaps its label, so Reconnect never pops in. An error opens a message panel under the row. New rows grow in from zero height, then their content fades up; the list stays pinned to the new row as it grows. Replay re-enters the rows 60ms apart.
api: chip.set(state)   act.put(label)   err.h.set(state === error)   row.open(true, t + i·0.06)   connect: busy → queue +1.5s → ok | error

name: OAuth consent screen
summary: Each scope toggle springs its knob, and the Allow count rolls. Turning on a sensitive scope grows a warning line under it. Allow morphs the button row: Deny shrinks to zero width while Allow grows, fills green and swaps to Connected, then the scopes you left off collapse 40ms apart and the toggles of the kept ones swap to checks. Deny runs the mirror image and fades red. The link between the two tiles fills as the grant lands.
api: switch[i].set(v)   count.set(n)   allow: deny.w.set(0) → off-rows.h.set(0, t + i·0.04) → kept.toggle.swap(check)   line.fill.set(1)

name: Tool call approval
summary: The card holds one request at a time. Next request swaps the whole request block, and the card height eases from the old height to the new one. Show all arguments grows the preview on the base spring and swaps its label. Allow once or Always allow swaps the buttons for a running line with a live timer, then swaps that for the result; Deny goes straight to the result. The card height follows each swap without a jump.
api: req.to(next)   args.h.set(open ? full : 3 lines)   zone.swap(ask → run, t + EXIT)   queue +dur → zone.swap(result)

name: Tool call log
summary: Calls stream in on a run clock, newest at the top. Each row grows from zero height and its content fades up; the spinner turns on that clock, then swaps to a check or an error as the call finishes, and the duration stops counting. Several calls overlap, so more than one spinner can run. Pause freezes the run clock without losing the queue. Click a row to grow its arguments and result; failed rows open on the error.
api: rt += dt (unless paused)   at ≥ call.at → row.open(true)   at ≥ call.at + dur → icon.swap(check | error)   expand: detail.h.set(open)

name: Server tool permissions
summary: Switches spring one by one. Enable all read-only turns on every read tool still off, 60ms apart from the top, and the button swaps to a Read-only tools enabled label once none are left; flipping any read tool off brings the original label back. The filter indicator edges lag each other, and tools outside the filter collapse in height rather than disappearing. Enabling a destructive tool grows a warning line under it.
api: tool[i].sw.set(1, t + i·0.06)   bulk.swap(allRead ? done : enable)   filter: ind.go(l, r), row.open(match)   destructive: warn.h.set(on)

name: API key reveal and rotate
summary: Create key grows the form open and swaps its own label to Cancel. Creating collapses the form, grows the one-time reveal panel in its place and drops the new row in from zero height with a New tag. Copy swaps to Copied with a green fill and falls back after 1.8s. Done closes the panel and fades the tag. Rotate and Revoke open an inline confirmation under the row; Rotate swaps the masked prefix and reopens the reveal, Revoke dims the row, swaps its line to Revoked, then collapses it.
api: form.open(v)   create: form.open(0) → reveal.open(1, +0.3), row.open(1)   copy: label.swap(Copied), +1.8s swap back   revoke: row.dim → +0.7s row.open(0)

name: Server connection health
summary: Connecting walks four steps in order: each swaps its ring for a spinner, then a check, 450 to 600ms apart, and the chip morphs to Connected when the last lands. The latency number rolls digit by digit with each ping while the sparkline shifts one bar left and every bar springs to its neighbor’s height. Simulate outage drops the bars flat and morphs everything to the error state; a countdown rolls down, the first auto retry fails at Initialize, and the second succeeds. Retry now skips the wait.
api: steps[i]: wait → run → done | fail   latency.set(ms)   bars[i].set(vals[i+1])   outage: bars.set(0, t + i·0.02), err.open(1)   countdown = ceil(retryAt − t)

name: Agent permission matrix
summary: Each cell is a checkbox. Toggling springs the fill and check, and the cell takes a full outline (ink for added, red with a faint check for removed) so the change is visible before saving. The pending panel grows up from the bottom edge and each change enters as its own row. The header chip morphs to Can publish or delete as soon as one of those grants is on. Save swaps to a spinner, then Saved, collapses the rows and settles every outline; Discard springs everything back.
api: cell.p.set(draft)   cell.q.set(draft ≠ saved)   diff.open(any)   diff[key].open(add | remove)   save: label.swap(spin → Saved), q.set(0), panel.open(0, +0.7)

name: Link groups with descriptions
summary: Hovering a top item waits 120 ms before the panel opens, with a hairline filling the wait. The panel grows from the bar, then its links rise one after another. Moving to another item keeps the panel open: its height morphs at once, the old links leave in 100 ms, then the new ones enter. At phone width the same groups become accordions in one sheet.
api: ctl.hover(i) → wait 120ms → panel.o.set(1) → links.stagger(+25ms)   ctl.hover(j) → H.set(h) → swap(j)

name: Featured card with links
summary: Hover waits 120 ms, then the panel grows from the bar. The promo card rises first, the links follow in a 30 ms stagger. Switching top items keeps the panel: its height morphs, the old content leaves in 100 ms, the new promo and links enter in the same order. At phone width the links become accordions and the promo moves to the bottom of the sheet.
api: panel.o.set(1) → promo.rise(t0) → links.rise(t0 + 60ms + i·30ms)   swap(j): H.set(h), exit 100ms, enter

name: Vertical tabs, hover to swap
summary: Hovering a row on the left waits 70 ms so a quick pass across the list changes nothing. The selection plate then moves with lagging edges, leading edge first, and the right pane swaps: old content out in 100 ms, new content in from the direction of travel. Arrow keys follow the same path. At phone width each category becomes a nested accordion.
api: rail.hover(k) → wait 70ms → plate.go(top, bottom) → detail.to(k, dir)   ArrowRight → focus first link

name: Icon grid of products
summary: Tiles arrive on a diagonal: top-left first, each neighbor 30 ms later. One plate glides between tiles with lagging edges, and the hovered icon fills with the accent on the same spring. Switching from Products to Integrations morphs the panel height and swaps the grid. At phone width the grids sit inside accordions as compact tiles.
api: tile[r,c].rise(t0 + 30ms·(r + c))   plate.go(rect)   icon.fill.set(hover)   H.set(h)

name: Search inside the menu
summary: Opening search grows the panel from the bar and puts the caret in the field. Each keystroke filters at once: rows that no longer match blur out in 100 ms, the survivors slide up into the gap, and rows that now match arrive last. The panel height follows the list. The highlight plate trails the arrow keys. On a phone, search takes over the whole screen instead.
api: q → filter → leaving.o.set(0) → stay.y.set(rank·52) → entering.o.set(1)   panel.H.set(base + n·52)

name: Full-width image cards
summary: The panel unrolls from the header edge on one spring. Cards then arrive left to right: each picture rises first, its words follow 60 ms later. One plate trails the pointer between cards, and the picture under it eases up. Moving to another top item swaps the cards in place. At phone width the cards become a swipeable row inside each accordion.
api: panel.reveal.set(1) → thumb[i].rise(t0 + 40ms·i) → body[i].rise(t0 + 60ms + 40ms·i)   plate.go(card)

name: Nested flyout, three levels
summary: Hover waits 120 ms before the first level opens. Each row waits 100 ms before its submenu flies out to the right. While you travel toward an open submenu the pointer is inside a safe triangle between where you left the row and the submenu’s edge: rows you cross on the way do not switch for 350 ms. Leave the triangle and the switch comes in 50 ms. Arrow keys follow the menu pattern; Escape closes one level at a time.
api: row.hover → wait 100ms → sub.o.set(1)   in triangle(aim, sub.top, sub.bottom) → hold 350ms   Esc → close level, focus parent row

name: Morphing dropdown with caret
summary: There is one panel. Hover waits 120 ms, then it fades in with its caret under the item. Moving to another item never closes it: the caret slides first, the panel follows with lagging edges, width and height morph together, the old content leaves in 100 ms and the new content enters from the direction of travel. Leaving the bar closes it after 220 ms.
api: caret.x.set(trigger.cx)   panel.{x, w, h}.set(pane)   content.to(k, dir)   open: one fade, never a second panel

name: Command menu
summary: Hover Go to, Create or Account waits 120 ms, then the palette opens already scoped to that group. Moving to another group keeps it open: rows that leave blur out in 100 ms, the rest slide into the gap, the group’s own rows arrive last. ⌘K or Ctrl+K opens it with the keyboard; the plate follows the arrow keys and Enter runs the command. On a phone it is a bottom sheet with touch-sized rows.
api: scope.set(g) → rows.leave(o→0) → rows.stay(y→rank) → rows.enter(o→1)   ⌘K → open, focus input   Enter → run, close, focus trigger

name: Drill-down menu with back
summary: The menu button opens one panel (on hover after 120 ms, or on click). A row with a chevron pushes the next level in from the right while the current one slides back 30% and fades. The header title swaps in the direction of travel and the Back button fades in with the parent’s name. Back, Escape and a drag from the left edge all pop a level: the drag follows the finger 1:1 and settles from its release velocity.
api: push: next.x.set(0), cur.x.set(−1)   header.to(title, dir)   back: reverse   drag: x.jump(dx/W) → release(v)

name: Header: logo, links, call to action
summary: Click a link and the underline slides to it, the leading edge first and the trailing edge 60ms behind. Change the alignment and the link group glides across the free space between logo and actions. Sign in morphs the account zone: the width springs to the avatar while the buttons blur out and the avatar blurs in. Narrow: the burger becomes a cross, a drawer slides in from the right over a dimmed page, then each link enters 40ms after the last and Product opens as an accordion.
api: underline.go(l, r)   links.x.set(align × freeSpace)   acts.w.set(signed ? avatar : buttons)   drawer.x.set(0)   link[i].o.set(1, S.base, t + .08 + i·.04)

name: Header: logo centered, links split
summary: The logo stays optically centered while the links split around it. Hover grows a short underline from each link’s center; click widens it to a full underline on the same spring. The alignment option slides each half toward the logo or toward the edges, using whatever room is left after the account zone morphs. Narrow: burger on the left, logo centered, and the menu opens as a dropdown whose height morphs open under the header with links entering in order.
api: half.x.set(align × (box − links))   underline.scaleX = max(current, .4 × hover)   panel.h.set(natural)

name: Header: links, logo centered, actions
summary: Each link fills with a soft plate on its own spring when hovered or focused, so moving across the row leaves a short trail. Signing in swaps Sign in and the button for a notifications bell and the avatar; the bell’s unread dot scales away when clicked. The avatar opens a menu whose rows enter 30ms apart. Narrow: the burger opens a drawer from the left edge over a dimmed page, and the account zone stays in the bar.
api: link.plate.set(hover)   acts.w.set(signed ? bell + avatar : buttons)   menu.rows[i].o.set(1, S.base, t + i·.03)   drawer.x.set(0)

name: Header: utility bar and main row
summary: Scroll past 40px and the utility row collapses in two beats: its text fades first, then its height springs to zero 60ms later, so the main row rides up to the top edge and the shadow fades in. Scrolling back to the top reverses it: height opens first, the text follows 100ms behind. The page never shifts because the header floats over it. Narrow: the utility row disappears and its links move to the bottom of the dropdown menu.
api: util.o.set(0); util.h.set(0, S.base, t + .06)   expand: util.h.set(1); util.o.set(1, S.base, t + .1)   shadow.o.set(scrolled)

name: Header: shrinks on scroll
summary: Past 16px of scroll the header compacts on a single spring: the bar goes from 88px to 56px, the logo scales from 1.18 to 1, the tagline folds away, the button height eases down, and the border and shadow fade in together. Back at the top it reverses on the same spring. Narrow: starts at 64px and shrinks to 52px, and the menu drops from beneath whichever height it is at.
api: k.set(scrollTop > 16)   h = lerp(88, 56, k)   logo.scale = lerp(1.18, 1, k)   tagline.h = (1 − k)·16   shadow.o = k

name: Header: hides on scroll down
summary: Scroll down past 80px and the header slides up out of the frame on a fast spring, leading with its bottom edge. The first upward scroll of 4px brings it back on a softer spring, so it leaves quickly and arrives gently. It also returns whenever focus moves into it, when a menu is open, and at the very top. The label below reads the current state.
api: dy = scrollTop − last   hide.set(dy > 4 && y > 80, S.snap)   show.set(dy < −4 || focusin || menuOpen, S.base)   header.y = −hide × (h + 2)

name: Header: transparent over hero
summary: Over the dark hero the header has no background, no border, and light ink. Scrolling 24px fills the background, fades in the border and shadow, and turns the logo, links and button ink from light to dark, all as one blend on one spring. Opening the narrow menu forces the solid state first so the panel never opens against a transparent bar. The button’s fill and text colors invert with the same blend.
api: k.set(scrollTop > 24 || menuOpen)   bg = card × k   ink = lerp(#EFF2F6, ink, k)   button.fill = lerp(#EFF2F6, ink, k)

name: Header: floating pill with plate
summary: One plate slides between links with lagging edges: it follows the pointer or keyboard focus, then returns to the current page when you leave. Scrolling lifts the pill’s shadow, tucks it 6px closer to the top, and folds the wordmark away so the pill narrows. The Pill option morphs the width between fit-to-content and full. Narrow: the same pill is a bar; the burger morphs it taller in place, its corner radius easing from 26px to 22px, and the links appear inside it one after another.
api: plate.go(l, r) on hover / focus, back to current on leave   pill.w.set(fit | full)   wordmark.w.set(scrolled ? 0 : natural)   pill.h.set(52 + panel)   links[i].o.set(1, S.base, t + .08 + i·.04)

name: Header: side rail
summary: Hover or focus the rail and it widens from 64px to 232px first; the labels fade in 60ms later, each 20ms after the last, so text never spills out of a half-open rail. Leaving reverses it: labels go first, then the width closes. The active plate slides between rows with lagging edges. Pinned keeps it open and the page slides over to make room. Narrow: the rail becomes a drawer opened from a top bar, with labels already showing.
api: rail.w.set(hover ? 232 : 64)   label[i].o.set(1, S.base, t + .06 + i·.02)   exit: labels.o.set(0); rail.w.set(64, S.base, t + .05)   page.pad.set(pinned ? 232 : 64)

name: Header: search expands in place
summary: Press the search icon (or “/”) and the pill widens in place to 320px while the links, centered in the room left over, are pushed toward the logo; when they no longer fit they blur out instead of wrapping. The results panel drops from the field with its height following the number of matches; typing collapses non-matching rows and keeps the rest. Narrow: the field takes the whole bar, the logo and menu button fold away together, and Cancel slides in.
api: search.w.set(open ? 320 : 36)   links.x.set(align × (room − links)); links.o.set(fits)   rows[i].h.set(match ? 40 : 0)   panel.h.set(30 + Σ rows)   narrow: chrome.w.set(0); field.grow = open

name: Header: announcement bar
summary: Dismiss the bar and its text blurs out first (100ms), then the slot’s height springs to zero 60ms later, so the header and the whole page ride up into the freed space rather than leaving a gap. Show again opens the slot first and brings the text in 100ms behind. It lives above a sticky header, so once you scroll it leaves with the page and the header stays pinned. Narrow: the message left-aligns and wraps to two lines, and the slot measures itself.
api: dismiss: text.o.set(0, S.snap); slot.h.set(0, S.base, t + .06)   restore: slot.h.set(natural); text.o.set(1, S.base, t + .1)   focus → logo

name: Header: minimal with fullscreen menu
summary: The page header is only a wordmark, the account zone and a Menu button, at every width. Opening swaps the label Menu to Close, folds the two lines into a cross, and expands a dark layer as a circle growing out from the button until it covers the page. The header recolors to light ink at the same moment, then each link enters 60ms after the last, and hovering one dims the others. Escape closes it and focus returns to the button.
api: overlay.r = open × reach(button → far corner)   header.ink = lerp(ink, card, open)   link[i].o.set(1, S.base, t + .14 + i·.06)   hover: others.o.set(.4)

name: Minimal footer
summary: Hovering or tabbing to a link draws its underline left to right on a snap spring while the text darkens; leaving wipes the line out toward the right. Back to top nudges its arrow up, then the page scrolls home on a soft spring and focus lands on the page heading. Wheel, touch or any key cancels the scroll mid-flight.
api: link.p.set(hover ? 1 : 0, S.snap)   underline.scaleX = p, origin = hover ? left : right   scroll.jump(y).set(0, S.soft)

name: Centered footer with social icons
summary: Links draw their underline on hover. The social icons share one plate: entering the row fades it in under the nearest icon, moving along the row stretches it with the leading edge first and the trailing edge 60ms behind, and each glyph inks up as the plate passes under it. Back to top springs the page home.

name: Four-column footer
summary: Brand block and four link groups. As the footer scrolls into view each block fades up 10px, left to right, 45ms apart; scrolling back out resets them so the entrance replays. Links draw underlines, and Changelog, Status and Careers carry a pill or an arrow that nudges on hover. Layout is container-driven: five columns, then brand over four columns, then two by two.
api: block[i].set(top < viewBottom − 24 ? 1 : 0, S.soft, now + i·45ms)   link.underline.scaleX = hover

name: Footer with newsletter signup
summary: Submit an invalid address and the field rings danger red while a message opens beneath. A valid one shrinks the button to a spinner, then resolves one of three ways: success turns the button green with a check, then the whole field morphs into a tinted confirmation; a server failure turns the button red with Try again; an address already on the list rings the field amber. Columns rise into view in order as the footer scrolls in.
api: plan(busy → ok | err | warn)   ring = mix(ok, warning, danger)   button.w.set(44)   field.bg → success-tint   msg.to(i)

name: Accordion footer on mobile
summary: Below 520px each column becomes a disclosure: the chevron rotates 180° and the panel’s height springs open while its links rise in one after another, 70ms apart. Other sections keep their own state. If the footer was at the bottom of the page the scroll stays pinned there, so the opening list is never pushed off screen. At wider widths the same markup is plain columns and the buttons disappear.

summary: The playhead is the only state: the page, the cursor, the typed text, the pins and the highlighted event are all pure functions of its position. Dragging it moves 1:1 and the page jumps to that moment; on release it coasts a few pixels from your release velocity. Play advances it at 1× or 2×, the event row at the playhead lifts and the list scrolls to keep it centred, and clicking a row glides the playhead there on a spring.

When a task finishes, a handoff arrow draws from its end to the start of the next agent’s task, and that bar starts growing as the arrow lands.
